(2) DROP — useFileDrop→openImage was already wired on the bench; it now survives real payloads. (3) THE SHARED LOAD PATH, diagnosed not buried: typed/dropped paths arrive shell-quoted, file://-prefixed (DE drops), or whitespace-wrapped — magick identify then fails and the old status said nothing. cleanImagePath() now sits INSIDE store.openImage so the picker, the drop, and the typed field share one load door (headless, P4-pinned across quote/file-uri/whitespace cases), and the failure status points the user at the picker/drop instead of dying quietly; magick itself verified working on this host. Opened images land as paintable documents exactly like the original (native dims, srcPath source — paint over, extract from) and the DRAFTHOLE slot law covers them across hot updates. bench 14/14.
